what: 望 (wàng): what is trending in Chinese media right now, translated. A feed to explore. Nothing here is scored or read by Prism.
source: Each platform's own public hot list, read directly by chinavision-pull.py. Not read this time: Zhihu: HTTPError HTTP Error 403: Forbidden.
notesBy: Accounts, quotes and reception are written by local:qwen, on this Mac from the news pages it read. Reception is what those pages themselves report; no comment threads are read. Accounts are in its own words; a quote is kept only when it is found exactly in its source and is short. The full texts stay on this Mac (data/chinavision/raw/) and are not shown. Checked by Claude on 11-19: one account was withdrawn (the article was about something else) and one headline translation was corrected (it had left out Russia).

items.zh: 中俄美元首会晤富有成果
items.en: The meeting of the Chinese, Russian and American presidents was fruitful
items.note: Chinese state media reports that Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and US President Donald Trump held a historic meeting in Shenzhen on November 19. The article states that Xi outlined four principles for managing great power relations, emphasizing mutual respect and peaceful coexistence to avoid conflict. Experts quoted in the report argue that this approach offers a new framework for stability and addresses global hotspots like the Ukraine crisis and nuclear proliferation. The three leaders reportedly exchanged views on major international issues and issued a joint peace declaration following the talks.

items.zh: 马斯克从深圳飞到了上海
items.en: Elon Musk flew from Shenzhen to Shanghai
items.note: Elon Musk traveled from Shenzhen to Shanghai as part of a brief 24-hour trip to China, which was highlighted by Tesla executive Tao Lin. During this visit, Musk expressed admiration for the Shanghai Super Factory's manufacturing capabilities and the local team's efficiency. He emphasized that resources should be dedicated to creating useful products rather than short-term speculation. The article notes that the Shanghai factory is a critical hub for Tesla's global production and exports.

items.zh: 2026APEC东道主成果清单
items.en: 2026 APEC host country achievement list
items.note: This article outlines China's strategy for hosting the 2026 APEC meetings in Shenzhen, focusing on transforming past diplomatic promises into concrete, actionable results. It highlights key initiatives in digital economy and artificial intelligence cooperation, such as the establishment of a new data flow center in Shenzhen's Qianhai district. The piece also emphasizes how the host city is using the event to test and improve its business environment and regulatory frameworks. Ultimately, the report presents this approach as a method to provide sustainable public goods and drive regional integration in the Asia-Pacific.

items.zh: 中俄美元首会晤
items.en: China-Russia-US heads of state meeting
items.note: Chinese state media reports that President Xi Jinping of China, President Vladimir Putin of Russia, and President Donald Trump of the United States held a historic trilateral meeting in Shenzhen on November 19. The article presents this event as a unique opportunity for the three major powers to define their relationship based on mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, win-win cooperation, and dialogue. It highlights a joint declaration issued after the talks, which addresses global issues such as the Ukraine crisis, nuclear non-proliferation, and UN reform. The piece frames the summit as a constructive step toward stabilizing international relations and preventing conflict among the world's leading nations.

words.en: When major powers are at peace, the world is secure

items.zh: 中俄美元首和平宣言
items.en: Peace declaration by the leaders of China, Russia, and the United States
items.note: Chinese state media reports that Chinese President Xi Jinping met with Russian President Vladimir Putin and US President Donald Trump in Shenzhen to discuss how major powers should coexist. The article states the leaders issued a joint peace declaration outlining principles such as mutual respect and dialogue to prevent conflict. It highlights the view that this meeting offers a new path for international stability by avoiding historical traps of great power rivalry. Experts quoted in the piece emphasize that the three nations must work together to resolve global hotspots and maintain peace.

words.en: When major powers are at peace, the world is secure

items.zh: 世界目光聚焦APEC
items.en: World attention focuses on APEC
items.note: Over 2,000 business and political leaders from APEC economies and other nations gathered in Shenzhen for the 2026 APEC CEO Summit to discuss regional economic priorities. Attendees emphasized keywords such as stability, openness, and green innovation, expressing a desire for predictable growth amidst rising protectionism and geopolitical uncertainty. Many participants highlighted China's role as a key partner and innovator in areas like artificial intelligence and sustainable development. The report frames these discussions as a collective search for cooperation and mutual benefit within the Asia-Pacific region.

words.en: Without stability, there is no growth
